items.title: First snow, coldest air in months headed for eastern US in wake of storm
items.brief: Winter will make its first cameo in the eastern United States later this week as a storm ushers in the coldest temperatures in six months for tens of millions of people and the first snow for some.

items.title: Kennedy family sues to block Trump’s arch
items.brief: One of America’s most storied political dynasties — the Kennedy family — is suing the Trump administration to block construction of the president’s 250-foot triumphal arch .

items.title: 2026 was the year of tennis star Alexandra Eala – and she brings a nation with her
items.brief: Hues of royal blue, red, white, and yellow flashed at every corner of the tennis court as the crowd rallied around Alexandra Eala.

items.title: Man accused of raping three women in New York’s Central Park is arrested in Miami
items.brief: A man accused of raping three women in New York’s Central Park over the span of five years has been arrested in Florida, police announced Tuesday.

items.title: A Virginia man is convicted of murder after admitting he dismembered his wife. But he still says he didn’t kill her
items.brief: A jury found Virginia man Naresh Bhatt guilty of first-degree murder Tuesday, rejecting his claim on the stand that his wife died by suicide.

items.title: Thomas Massie’s articles of impeachment against Pete Hegseth, explained
items.brief: House GOP leadership on Tuesday killed, for now, an effort from within their ranks to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth .

items.title: Man arrested after woman found dead in her room aboard a cruise ship hours after departing Galveston
items.brief: A Texas man has been arrested and is facing a federal murder charge after a woman was found dead in her room on a cruise ship “with multiple facial injuries,” according to the criminal complaint in the case.
